name: Permit Research
description: Guides the user through the process of determining whether a home improvement project requires a building permit, how to research local requirements, and how to navigate the permit application process. Produces a research checklist and permit decision framework. Use when the user asks whether they need a permit, how to find local building codes, how to apply for a building permit, or what happens if they skip a permit. Do NOT use for commercial construction permits, zoning variance applications, or specific jurisdiction permit rules (this skill teaches the research process, not jurisdiction-specific requirements).
